rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something or someone moving fast.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ce1 haang4 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for someone who is mentally alert and reacts or understands quickly.

example.english: They are quick to understand and get it as soon as they hear it.
example.jyutping: keoi5 faan2 jing3 faai3 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this for someone who thinks quickly on the spot and is witty.

example.english: They are quick on their feet and are always coming up with clever ideas.
example.traditional: 佢轉數快，成日都諗到啲鬼主意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zyun2 sou3 faai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 dou2 di1 gwai2 zyu2 ji3

rows.note: Use this colloquial word for someone who becomes angry easily.

example.english: My coworker is quick to anger and loses their temper over the slightest thing.
example.traditional: 我個同事好燥底，少少事就發脾氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tung4 si6 hou2 cou3 dai2 siu2 siu2 si6 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3
